ex.s: But it was the effects deep within the fat cells that may have been the most significant, the researchers found.

ex.s: There has been a recent trend in the food service industry toward lower fat content and less salt.

ex.s: Fat and salt are very important parts of a diet.
ex.t: 脂肪和盐是饮食中非常重要的组成部分。

defs.def: thick or wide 厚的；宽大的

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果片混合时，冷冻香蕉是制作浓稠凉爽的水果奶昔和低脂"冰淇淋"的绝佳基底。

defs.def: large in quantity; worth a lot of money 大量的；值钱的

ex.s: Both the fat and thin versions of the actor took a large amount of food.
ex.t: 这位演员的胖版和瘦版都吃了大量食物。

defs.def: a white or yellow substance in the bodies of animals and humans, stored under the skin 脂肪；肥肉

ex.s: The movie shows the assault on Troy by the Greek forces and described the fates of the men involved.
ex.t: 这部电影展现了希腊军队对特洛伊的进攻，并描述了参战者的命运。

ex.s: Most animals survive thanks to their fat, which protects them from the cold.
ex.t: 大多数动物靠脂肪生存，脂肪可以保护它们抵御严寒。

ex.s: All that fat has become muscle now.
ex.t: 所有的脂肪现在都变成了肌肉。

ex.s: I tried nofat, low-fat, 5:2, only bananas, no bananas—I almost went bananas, too.
ex.t: 我试过零脂肪、低脂肪、5:2 饮食法、只吃香蕉、不吃香蕉——我差点也疯了。

ex.s: Then I read an article that said instead of asking “Am I fat?” I should be asking “Am I fit?” I had no idea a letter could make such a difference!
ex.t: 后来我读到一篇文章，说我不应该问“我胖吗？”，而应该问“我健康吗？”我没想到一个字母的改变竟能带来这么大的不同！
